mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a frame material for my picture window?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a frame material for your picture window, consider factors like energy efficiency, durability, maintenance, and aesthetic appeal. Common options include vinyl, fiberglass, wood, and aluminum. Vinyl and fiberglass offer good insulation and low maintenance, while wood provides a classic look but requires more upkeep. Your choice impacts the window's performance and longevity, especially given the varying climates across our service area from Dublin to Hayward.
